risk_score.instructions: How risky is this code change?
criteria: no meaningful risk: docs, comments, formatting, tests only
low risk: small, local, easily reverted change
moderate risk: touches shared logic or several modules
high risk: touches auth, data integrity, public contracts, concurrency or infrastructure
severe risk: could cause a security breach, data loss or an outage

criticality.instructions: How critical is the code this change affects, to the business and the system?

criteria.low: peripheral code; failure is cosmetic or easily worked around
criteria.medium: ordinary product code; failure affects some users or one feature
criteria.high: core functionality or shared components; failure affects many users
criteria.critical: security, payments, data storage or availability of the whole system

human_review.instructions: Does this change need a human code review?

criteria.recommended: a human reviewer would add value but is not essential
criteria.required: a human must review this before it is merged

ux_review.instructions: Does this change need UX or accessibility review?

criteria.none: no user-facing behaviour or appearance changes
criteria.automated: user-facing change that automated UI and accessibility checks can cover
criteria.specialist: new or changed user journey that a UX specialist should verify

security_review.instructions: Does this change need security review?

criteria.none: no security-relevant code or configuration is touched
criteria.automated: security-relevant, but static analysis and dependency audit are sufficient
criteria.specialist: authentication, authorization, secrets, crypto, input handling or exposure that a security specialist should review

performance_review.instructions: Does this change need performance review?

criteria.automated: possible effect that benchmarks or performance regression tests can cover
criteria.specialist: hot path, query, concurrency or large-data change that needs profiling or load testing
